title: Phase 6A - Information-Theoretic Analysis: Architecture, Data and Feasibility Audit
status: AUDIT COMPLETE - NO ENTROPY OR MUTUAL-INFORMATION COMPUTATION PERFORMED

scope.objective: Audit existing architecture, experiment outputs, available variables and statistical requirements so Phases 6B-6G can be specified without inventing capability that does not exist.
scope.research_question: What task-relevant information is present in neural activity, and how does it relate to sensory inputs, motor outputs and reward?
scope.framework: Shannon information theory: H(X), H(X,Y), I(X;Y), I(X;Y|Z).
not_performed: no entropy computed on any dataset
no mutual information computed on any dataset
no modification of Phase 3, Phase 4 or Phase 5 source files
no modification of completed experiment outputs
no modification of datasets or connectomes

definitions_declared_for_later_phases.H(X): Shannon entropy of a discrete variable X in bits, base-2 logarithm.
definitions_declared_for_later_phases.H(X,Y): Joint Shannon entropy using the same marginal discretisation each variable uses individually.
definitions_declared_for_later_phases.I(X;Y): H(X) + H(Y) - H(X,Y); non-negative in expectation, upward-biased under plug-in estimation.
definitions_declared_for_later_phases.I(X;Y|Z): Conditional MI, evaluated as a weighted average of within-stratum I(X;Y) over discrete strata of Z.
definitions_declared_for_later_phases.normalised_mi: I(X;Y) / min(H(X), H(Y)); reported only when min entropy exceeds a declared floor.

preserved_findings.statement: Sensory neurons were stimulated, but effective downstream propagation to motor populations was not established. Actual sensory events did not produce a distinguishable propagated response against the tested controls. Highest evidence grade E2.
preserved_findings.reused_as: Constrains 6D and 6E: no established sensory-to-motor channel exists to measure information over.

preserved_findings.statement: Round-trip condition totals: B (stimulated) 3562, C (shuffled timing) 3760, D (random placement) 3648, E (intact control) 3561, F 0, G 0.
preserved_findings.reused_as: Quantifies null-like spacing between stimulated and control conditions; a claimed information gain must exceed this spacing.

preserved_findings.statement: Fixed complete 0.795 +/- 0.084; plastic complete 0.945 +/- 0.023; paired difference +0.150; Holm-adjusted p = 0.00781; Cohen dz = 2.012.
preserved_findings.reused_as: The only established behavioural effect in the project; 6F must explain it in information terms without altering it.

preserved_findings.statement: Action selectivity 0.192, below the 0.25 chance level.
preserved_findings.reused_as: Warns that action selection is not demonstrably selective; neural-to-action information endpoints may be uninformative by construction.

preserved_findings.statement: Biological interpretation of the plasticity result is INCONCLUSIVE.
preserved_findings.reused_as: Phase 6 language about biological plausibility must remain inconclusive absent new evidence.

feasibility.limitation: Raw observation vectors are not stored; only the coarse event code is available.

feasibility.question: Entropy of the sensory population
feasibility.verdict: FEASIBLE ONLY AS A DECLARED COARSE CODE
feasibility.data: DI-01, DI-02 (aggregates); requires regeneration for per-neuron data
feasibility.support: 138 mapped neurons are defined and reproducible.
feasibility.limitation: A 138-neuron binary state has 2^138 states; only a declared low-dimensional summary (e.g. population count in 2-4 bins) is estimable.

feasibility.question: Entropy of a neural spike train

feasibility.limitation: One 100 ms smoke run with 74 spikes cannot support entropy estimation beyond a few bins.

feasibility.question: Entropy of the motor output

feasibility.limitation: Scores are decoder outputs, not ground-truth motor command; must be labelled as decoder-derived.

feasibility.question: Entropy of the reward signal

feasibility.limitation: Small alphabet; near-deterministic in complete conditions, so entropy may be near zero.

feasibility.question: Mutual information sensory -> neural

feasibility.question: Mutual information neural -> reward

infeasible.analysis: Phase 4H condition-contrast MI (stimulated vs shuffled vs random)
infeasible.reason: Zero non-stimulated downstream spikes means both arms have degenerate distributions; MI is 0 by construction.
infeasible.would_require: A configuration where sensory stimulation produces distinguishable downstream activity.

infeasible.analysis: Joint entropy of the full 138-neuron sensory population
infeasible.reason: State space is 2^138; no sample size can populate it.
infeasible.would_require: A pre-declared coarse code (population count in 2-4 bins, or a small cluster label).

infeasible.analysis: MI computed by pooling every timestep as an independent sample
infeasible.reason: Timesteps are autocorrelated within an episode; treating them as independent inflates effective N and understates bias.
infeasible.would_require: Block bootstrap or episode-level aggregation before inference.

infeasible.analysis: Causal interpretation of any MI estimate
infeasible.reason: MI is symmetric and observational; it does not identify direction or mechanism.
infeasible.would_require: Perturbation or intervention design; MI may only be described as information shared.

infeasible.analysis: Fixed versus plastic neural-level MI from stored data
infeasible.reason: Neither condition saved spike trains; only task records and one weight checkpoint exist.
infeasible.would_require: Re-running both conditions with recording enabled.

primary.name: plug-in (maximum likelihood) discrete entropy and mutual information
primary.formula_MI: I(X;Y) = sum_x sum_y p(x,y) log2 [ p(x,y) / (p(x) p(y)) ]
primary.rationale: Transparent, deterministic and auditable; all later corrections are reported relative to it.
primary.known_defect: Upward bias of order (|X|-1)(|Y|-1)/(2 N ln 2) bits for MI.

corrections.name: Miller-Madow
corrections.use: first-order entropy correction, (K-1)/(2 N ln 2) with K observed non-empty bins

corrections.name: analytic bias subtraction
corrections.use: subtract the (|X|-1)(|Y|-1)/(2 N ln 2) MI floor and report the raw value alongside

corrections.name: Chao-Shen coverage-adjusted
corrections.use: optional check on undersampled discrete entropy; reported only as sensitivity

corrections.name: NSB
corrections.use: listed as future option only; not implemented and not required for 6B-6G

discretisation.rule: Every continuous quantity is converted to a declared discrete code before estimation; the code is part of the pre-registration, never chosen after seeing results.
schemes: fixed physiological thresholds where they exist
discretisation.sensitivity: All three bin counts are reported for every endpoint; no single binning is presented as the result.
discretisation.prohibition: Bins chosen to maximise MI are not permitted.

normalisation.uncertainty_coefficient: I(X;Y) / H(Y), reported with explicit direction
normalisation.floor_rule: If min(H(X), H(Y)) is below 0.1 bits, report normalised values as undefined rather than inflated.

conditional.method: weighted average of within-stratum I(X;Y) over discrete strata of Z
conditional.guard: Strata with fewer than the declared minimum samples are pooled or dropped, and the decision is reported.

exclusions: No continuous-density estimators (KSG and similar) in 6B-6G; all variables are discretised first.
No scipy dependency added for the estimator core.
Negative corrected estimates are clipped to zero and flagged, never reported as negative information.

statistics.replication_unit: The seed, not the timestep and not the window. Every inferential statement is computed over independent seeds; all timesteps and windows within a seed are treated as clustered observations.
independence_rules: Timesteps inside an episode are autocorrelated and are never counted as independent samples.
Decoder windows overlap in origin and are clustered by run.
Condition contrast uses paired seeds where the design is paired.
Any analysis that cannot respect clustering is reported as descriptive only.

bias.small_sample_warning: Below roughly N=50 the asymptotic expression understates the real bias; a per-run 5-window cell cannot support a 4x4 table.
bias.mitigation: Pool within seed to a 2x2 endpoint or aggregate across seeds before estimation; report the raw and corrected values together.

autocorrelation.handling: Block bootstrap over contiguous episode blocks, block length declared before analysis; no i.i.d. resampling of timesteps.
autocorrelation.diagnostic: Lag-1 autocorrelation reported for every continuous variable used.

null_models.name: time shuffle
null_models.description: permute the time axis of one variable, destroying temporal pairing and preserving marginals

null_models.name: trial shuffle
null_models.description: permute labels across independent trials or seeds

null_models.name: matched control draws
null_models.description: reuse the Phase 4H control-draw construction so null and real share the same wiring statistics

null_models.name: surrogate spike trains
null_models.description: rate-matched Poisson surrogates preserving per-neuron mean rate

statistics.confidence_intervals: Percentile bootstrap over seeds with a declared resample count; report 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles and the number of seeds.
statistics.multiple_comparison: Holm-Bonferroni over the pre-declared core endpoint family per phase, exactly as Phase 5F; exploratory endpoints are descriptive only.
effect_sizes: paired difference in bits with CI
statistics.negative_results: A near-zero MI is a reportable result when the null distribution is documented. No endpoint may be dropped for being null.
statistics.pre_registration: Every 6B-6G phase declares endpoints, bin counts, N thresholds, null models and the Holm family before any estimate is computed.
interpretation_rules: Information shared is not causal influence.
Decoder-derived MI measures consistency with the decoder, not with the true motor command.
Correlated timesteps are never counted as independent samples.
A bias-corrected negative estimate is clipped to zero and flagged.

proposed_phases.title: Entropy of sensory state, neural population, spike trains, motor output and reward
proposed_phases.objective: Establish estimable entropy endpoints with declared discretisations and sample-size gates.
proposed_phases.gate: Each endpoint must reach its declared N threshold (>=65 for a 4x4 table) before any corrected value is reported.

proposed_phases.title: Mutual information between the four declared variable pairs
proposed_phases.gate: Bias-corrected estimate must exceed the 95th percentile of its null distribution to be called present.

proposed_phases.title: Actual sensory conditions versus shuffled and matched controls
proposed_phases.objective: Test whether real sensory conditions carry more downstream information than shuffled or matched controls.
proposed_phases.gate: BLOCKED until a propagation-positive configuration exists; the stored 4H data have zero downstream events in the control arms.

proposed_phases.title: Neural-to-motor information using decoder output
proposed_phases.objective: Quantify how much action-score information is present in population activity.
endpoints: uncertainty coefficient of score given neural state
proposed_phases.gate: Every result must carry the label decoder-derived; no claim about the true motor command is permitted.

proposed_phases.title: Fixed versus plastic information
proposed_phases.objective: Compare information in fixed and plastic conditions at task level, and at neural level once recording exists.
endpoints: task-level H(outcome) and I(cue;action) fixed vs plastic
neural-level I(cue;spikes) fixed vs plastic (requires recording)
proposed_phases.gate: Task-level is feasible now; neural-level is gated on the 6B recording campaign. The preserved +0.150 difference must be explained, not re-derived.

proposed_phases.title: Statistical validation and reporting
proposed_phases.objective: Apply bias correction, permutation nulls, block bootstrap, Holm correction and effect sizes uniformly, and publish negative results.
controls: all null models from every phase
proposed_phases.gate: No phase is considered complete until its 6G block exists.

risks.risk: Finite-sample MI bias is reported as information
risks.impact: A 4x4 table at N=40 carries 0.162 bits of pure bias, comparable to many real effects.
risks.mitigation: Report raw and corrected values together; enforce the N>=65 gate.

risks.risk: Autocorrelated timesteps inflate effective sample size
risks.impact: Confidence intervals become too narrow and nulls are rejected spuriously.
risks.mitigation: Block bootstrap and seed-level clustering; lag-1 autocorrelation reported.

risks.impact: The same data can appear informative or uninformative depending on bins.
risks.mitigation: Pre-register bins, report 2/3/4 bins for every endpoint, forbid post-hoc bin search.

risks.impact: MI reflects the linear decoder rather than the population's motor content.
risks.mitigation: Label all such endpoints decoder-derived; add a shuffled-decoder baseline.

risks.risk: Phase 4H control arms have zero downstream events
risks.impact: 6D contrasts are degenerate and any MI is zero by construction.
risks.mitigation: Mark 6D blocked; do not report a null as evidence of absence of propagation beyond the existing E2 grade.

risks.risk: Per-step instrumentation would require editing Phase 4 source
risks.impact: Would violate the protection constraint on brain/ and phase 4 files.
risks.mitigation: Use only PlasticSimulator.step_callback, which already exists, or record outside the simulator.

risks.impact: Full-population potentials at 0.5 ms over 3.3 s need about 4.55 GB per run; only 0.97 GiB was available at audit.
risks.mitigation: Record pools only (about 27.4 MB per run for 1037 neurons) and stream to disk.

risks.risk: SpikeRecorder capacity limits truncate long runs
risks.impact: Silent loss of spikes would corrupt entropy estimates.
risks.mitigation: Check recorded count against capacity on every save; fail loudly on overflow.

risks.risk: MI is read as causal influence
risks.impact: Scientific overclaim and contradiction of Phase 4H evidence grading.
risks.mitigation: Standing interpretation rule; every report repeats the non-causal caveat.

risks.impact: 6B-5 may return ~0 bits and look like a failure.
risks.mitigation: Pre-declare zero as an acceptable result and report the full distribution.

risks.impact: Neural-to-action endpoints may be structurally uninformative.
risks.mitigation: Pre-declare a null outcome as publishable.

risks.risk: Mixing aggregate and simulated provenance in one table
risks.impact: False comparisons between quantities measured under different conditions.
risks.mitigation: Every row carries source_id and provenance from the inventory; sources.py enforces the tag.

assumptions.assumption: Discrete alphabets of 2-4 bins are an adequate summary of each continuous variable.
assumptions.if_violated: Estimates understate true information; binning sensitivity tables reveal it.
Entropy varies within episode; report per-segment estimates.

assumptions.assumption: Runs with different seeds are independent replicates.
assumptions.if_violated: Permutation and bootstrap invalid; must fall back to descriptive reporting.

assumptions.assumption: The connectome and mapping are fixed across the analysis.
assumptions.if_violated: MI would mix structural with activity variability.

assumptions.assumption: Decoder scores are an acceptable proxy for motor output only when labelled decoder-derived.
Event labels from the perception pipeline are the sensory identity ground truth.
assumptions.if_violated: Sensory entropy measures detector error, not stimulus entropy.

assumptions.assumption: No task-relevant latent variable is omitted.
assumptions.if_violated: Conditional MI is reported as a lower bound only.

assumptions.assumption: The analytic 4x4 bias expression is applicable at the declared N.
assumptions.if_violated: Report uncorrected values with the small-sample warning attached.
